input: Generated flat high-contrast three-line fixture, NOT a real cryovial
limitations: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 is independent of the Tesseract baselines; this comparison alone does not establish a stronger engine on real cryovials.
Engine confidence is not an accuracy probability.
No character accuracy score without a human-verified visible-only transcript.
Boxes are normalized in each rotated ROI; variant images accompany results.
Do not fill occluded glyphs from an expected sample ID.

limits: Ambiguous lines have detection metrics only, never a guessed transcript.
IoU threshold 0.15 establishes one-to-one physical-line matches.
Character error rate can exceed 1 and does not certify clinical correctness.
Cloud browser timing is not iPhone latency.
